messages.sourceText: If DLSS is unavailable after changing OptiScaler settings, restart the game.
You can use FSR 4 as an OptiScaler input regardless of your GPU.
Reduce the in-game sharpening setting if the image looks oversharpened.
Use borderless windowed mode for reliable overlay access.
Disable the Ubisoft Connect in-game overlay and HDR while using OptiScaler to avoid severe ghosting.
Change the in-game FSR quality setting once so OptiScaler can detect the FSR 2 input.
Disable Frame Smoothing in the game settings to remove the frame-rate cap.
Set anti-aliasing quality to at least Medium (2×) in the game settings.
Set anti-aliasing quality to Epic in the game settings.
Set anti-aliasing to High TAA in the game settings.
Select TXAA 6× anti-aliasing in the game settings.
DirectX 11 can have lower performance and severe shimmer.
For better performance, prefer FSR or XeSS mode, or use OptiPatcher.
Use the game's resolution scale control to adjust the OptiScaler input resolution.
The XeSS input can show black block artifacts in cutscenes and some levels.
Opening or closing the inventory can cause issues while using OptiScaler.
When using FSR 4, select the Non-Linear sRGB input color space to avoid ghosting.
With FSR 4, select Non-Linear PQ Input if you encounter rare skybox issues.
When using FSR 4, some characters' hair and the second floor of DESCENT INTO SUBCONSCIOUS can show severe visual artifacts.
Use DLSS input: OptiScaler does not detect the in-game FSR 3 setting.
Run the game in DirectX 12 mode.
Use the default DirectX 11 mode. Forcing DirectX 12 with -dx12 crashes at startup.
Set the in-game resolution scale below 100% so OptiScaler can detect the FSR 2 input.
At launch, the game can reset the selected preset to Performance. Check the preset in the OptiScaler overlay. If this happens, select another preset, then select the desired one again.
When using FSR 4, select the Non-Linear sRGB input color space to fix flicker in some scenes.
When using FSR 4 through DLSS or XeSS, select the Non-Linear input color space to avoid black screens and flicker.
Enable both TAA and DLSS in the game settings.
Disable Display Res.MV in the game settings to fix shimmer.
When using FSR 4 with DLSS input, enable AutoExposure.
Change the in-game FSR setting once so OptiScaler can detect the FSR input.
Run the game in DirectX 12 mode.
Use the keyboard to navigate the OptiScaler overlay; mouse input is unavailable.
In the game settings, change the DLSS mode and apply the change.
Complete shader compilation before selecting FSR 4 to avoid a crash.
To use a DLSS input, enable ray tracing and NVIDIA spoofing.
When using FSR 4, select the Non-Linear sRGB input color space to fix screen flicker.
If surfaces sparkle, set Cinematic Reflections to Ultra or lower.

Disable motion blur in the game settings to reduce ghosting around Isaac's head.
